text: おれは　まけるのが　だい　きらい　なんだ！

structure.jp: だい　きらい　なんだ！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing' in English. まけるのが きらい = 'I hate losing'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives an explaining, emphatic tone, and it needs な after words like きらい. It is the spoken form of のだ. きらい なんだ = 'I hate it, you see'.
